name: display-dev
description: Publish, inspect, edit, and share HTML or Markdown artifacts with access controls.

interface.shortDescription: Publish, inspect, edit, and share artifacts.
interface.longDescription: Publish HTML and Markdown artifacts, browse and search published work, read bounded source context, make exact versioned edits, and share with public, private, or company-authenticated access. The Codex plugin bundles the display.dev skill and remote MCP server.
